description: Test suite for plugin key-value store operations in Mattermost, including CRUD, compare-and-set, expiration, and listing functionalities.

methods.name: TestPluginStore
methods.description: Main test function executing various plugin store operation tests.

methods.name: setupKVs
methods.description: Sets up key-value pairs for testing, including for the current and other plugins, and verifies their existence.

methods.name: doTestPluginSaveOrUpdate
methods.description: Tests SaveOrUpdate functionality for plugin key-value pairs with various scenarios.

methods.name: testPluginSaveOrUpdate
methods.description: Wrapper to test SaveOrUpdate using the generic function.

methods.name: doTestPluginCompareAndSet
methods.description: Tests CompareAndSet functionality with different conditions and expected outcomes.

methods.name: testPluginCompareAndSet
methods.description: Wrapper to test CompareAndSet using the generic function.

methods.name: testPluginCompareAndDelete
methods.description: Tests CompareAndDelete functionality under various conditions.

methods.name: testPluginSetWithOptions
methods.description: Tests SetWithOptions method for atomic and non-atomic operations, including validation and expiry scenarios.

methods.name: testPluginGet
methods.description: Tests retrieval of plugin key-value pairs, including non-existent, expired, and valid keys.

methods.name: testPluginDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of plugin key-value pairs, including expired and non-expired keys.

methods.name: testPluginDeleteAllForPlugin
methods.description: Tests deletion of all key-value pairs for a specific plugin.

methods.name: testPluginDeleteAllExpired
methods.description: Tests deletion of all expired key-value pairs across plugins.

methods.name: testPluginList
methods.description: Tests listing of plugin key-value keys with pagination, expiration filtering, and limits.
